The '''Jacques''' family were [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] that supported [[Ariq Joanson]] in his plans to make peace with the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand people]].
